description: The cockpit window may call the read-only cockpit command and nothing else. Narrowed (not just described that way): `cockpit` is an app-defined command, which Tauri's ACL always permits without a grant, and the frontend never calls any Tauri-provided `core:*` API -- so `permissions` is empty rather than `core:default`, which would otherwise hand the webview every core-plugin default (window, webview, app, event, menu, tray, image, path, resources) it never uses. VERIFICATION STATUS: unverified by any automated test. An earlier note here claimed a passing tauri::test::mock_builder check; that harness is not an oracle -- against the real generated context it reports `<command> not allowed. Plugin not found` identically under `[]`, under `core:default`, and with this file deleted, so it measures nothing about the ACL (issue #123). The only check that exercises the real IPC boundary is the manual smoke test in `app/README.md`; run it after editing this file.
